attempts.summary: Deployed a 3-member etcd 2.2.5 cluster (Ubuntu 16.04 i386, apt package) across node1/node2/node3 using systemd's etcd.service with static bootstrap config in /etc/default/etcd. Verified cross-member read/write consistency, demonstrated continued read/write availability with node3 offline and its catch-up on rejoin, then performed the mandatory sequential reboot-and-recover protocol on all three nodes with changed boot_id proof and post-restart cluster/data verification.
